What we stock

Three networks, 24 bundle sizes and two kinds of validity. MTN bundles are non-expiry — there is no validity clock at all, so whatever you do not use stays on the line. Telecel and AirtelTigo bundles are 60-day rollover, which means unused data carries over within that window instead of vanishing at midnight. Sizes run from 1GB (GH₵4.00, our cheapest entry bundle) to 100GB (GH₵405.00).

How buying works

1. Pick a bundle

Choose the network and the size. The price you see is the price you pay — there are no hidden fees and no fake "was" prices.

2. Enter the line

Any Ghanaian number on that network. The prefix is checked as you type and we warn you if it looks like a different network.

3. Pay with MoMo or card

Valmont-Pay checkout. You approve the charge on your own phone with your PIN — we never see it.

4. Data lands

Delivery starts when payment confirms and you can follow it live on the Track Order page.

A free Valmont Data account is required to place an order. It takes a minute (name, phone, email and a 4-digit PIN) and it is what lets you save numbers, track orders, use auto top-up and earn referral credit.

Delivery starts the moment payment confirms. Most bundles arrive within minutes; it depends on the network at the time. Every order gets a tracking reference and an SMS confirmation.

If a delivery fails we retry it automatically (up to three attempts) and refund it automatically if it still won't complete. Wrong numbers are not refundable — check the line before you pay.

You can buy for any number — yours, a family member's or a customer's. You do not have to be the account holder, and the site warns you if the prefix you typed belongs to a different network.

Questions people ask before buying

How much is a data bundle in Ghana?

Right now we sell 24 bundles from GH₵4.00 (AirtelTigo 1GB) to GH₵405.00 (Telecel 100GB). The full price list above is generated from our live catalogue, so it always matches what checkout charges.

Which network has the cheapest data per GB?

Telecel 50GB works out at GH₵3.60 per GB, the lowest per-GB price in our catalogue. On every network the bigger bundles cost less per GB, so if you use data steadily a larger bundle is the cheaper option over time.

Do the bundles expire?

MTN bundles are non-expiry — there is no validity period. Telecel and AirtelTigo bundles are 60-day rollover. Each row in the price table shows the validity for that bundle.

Can I pay with Mobile Money?

Yes. Payment goes through Valmont-Pay — MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AT Money or card. We never see or store your MoMo PIN: you approve every charge on your own phone.

Can I buy data for someone else's number?

Yes. You can buy for any number — yours, a family member's or a customer's. You do not have to be the account holder, and the site warns you if the prefix you typed belongs to a different network. You can also switch on automatic top-up for another line, so they get data when they run low — every charge still sends them, or you, a MoMo prompt to approve.

What happens if the data does not arrive?

If a delivery fails we retry it automatically (up to three attempts) and refund it automatically if it still won't complete. Wrong numbers are not refundable — check the line before you pay.

Do I need an account to buy?

A free Valmont Data account is required to place an order. It takes a minute (name, phone, email and a 4-digit PIN) and it is what lets you save numbers, track orders, use auto top-up and earn referral credit.
